notes.title: v1.0: Soon the release!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28122986/8fed77e02edefe0b0a0a14935c20c88b1ebd603c.png[/img]

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]
[list]
    [*]The text tool has been added to the editor
    [*]Changed the behavior of the bicycle
    [*]Changed camera
    [*]Changed character
    [*]Added grouping of objects in the editor (button G - group, U - ungroup)
    [*]Changed the choice of levels in the history mode
    [*]Added option to hide the trigger on the switch
    [*]Fixed object removal when drawing
    [*]We changed little bit here and there, that the game was even better!
[/list]

notes.title: v0.1.5: Big update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28122986/2b587e43e8e424f993ba71a59612bba002f1abab.png[/img]

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Faster loading of levels
[*]Added loading level
[*]Optimized loading times when testing and restart the level
[*]Removed on-screen keyboard
[*]Added effects to blur the background in the menu
[*]Added the inscription about the death of the character
[*]Improved blood effects
[*]Zoom in the game can be changed with the mouse wheel
[*]When a character dies he's not moving
[*]Now you can't finish if you died
[*]Zoom in the game can change with two fingers
[*]When a character dies he's not moving
[*]Now you can't finish if you died
[*]Bug fixes and other small changes
[/list]
